checks.name: two actual local wallets authenticate and enter a prize room
server agrees one immutable record and terms for both wallets
rejecting approval collects no entry and starts no fight
first confirmed transaction creates Funding and receives exactly one entry
one funded seat cannot start the authoritative fight
the second actual entry atomically activates the contract and starts play
server gameplay produces the real Finished result for the higher-HP player
signed outcome alone does not transfer or allocate escrow funds
original Solidity accepts the signed result and allocates the exact 95/5 split
allocation stays separate from the actual winner transfer
a real token-transfer failure preserves claimable winner credit
confirmed winner claim moves 1.90 USDC to the bound wallet exactly once
the losing wallet never sees a winner claim action
result pause blocks additional entry while keeping the sole-depositor cancel action
sole-depositor cancellation creates an exact refund credit without paying it out early
refund claim works during a pause, restores the full entry, and leaves treasury credit unchanged
a server-confirmed Void is accepted by Solidity and refunds both paid seats without a fee
both Void refunds can be claimed independently to restore their entries
private history restores an unsettled paid record without collecting another entry
persisted Forfeit signature pays the same winner/treasury split as Finished
a restored historical winner credit still transfers only to its bound wallet
wallet interaction used personal login signatures and explicit transaction requests
no uncaught JavaScript errors in real EVM payment flows

scope: Owned localhost Anvil chain 31337, original PaidDuelEscrowV2 bytecode, local MockUSDC, two real browsers with unlocked local EIP-1193 test accounts. Actual EVM receipts/balances/credits; no public-chain transactions or production signer use.
